controls.capability: valid_json_rate, public_factor_citation_rate, and legitimate_task_success in every curve row
controls.information_asymmetry: action-only and chain-of-thought monitors lack the private clinical note; oracle-context monitor receives it
controls.monitor_calibration: 160 balanced, policy-independent work-log probes: 80 explicit rule triggers and 80 safe, boundary, or missing-evidence cases
controls.no_scratchpad: both private-note orders sampled with Qwen thinking disabled; matched action-only results are nested in every curve row
controls.private_fact_order: the same safety and administrative lines are reordered, with exact matched facts and per-case token counts; safety-first is top-level and safety-last is nested in every curve row
controls.reasoning_load: easy single-trigger and compositional conjunction records nested in every curve row

experiment.monitor_timing: strictly post-hoc after all nine trajectories and 45 checkpoints were frozen; calibration and policy monitoring cannot affect training
